blocks.title: Bezier paths that leave as SVG
blocks.description: Paths, handles and fills — the upstream VectorCraft illustration app running inside Astravia, on your own machine, with the drawing you opened in the workspace.

showcase.user_prompt: In VectorCraft, redraw the wordmark in @assets/logo.svg as outlines and keep the original beside it.
showcase.assistant_reply: Outlined copy made from the live text and saved as logo-outlined.svg; the original is untouched. Captured the canvas so the curve can be checked at real size.

items.title: The real illustration app
items.description: The tab runs the official VectorCraft web build byte for byte. Upstream's wasm and JavaScript are not patched; only two thin files of ours are added around them.

items.title: Open and save inside your project
items.description: Opening uses the file selected in the Explorer, and output is written back through Astravia instead of a downloads folder.

items.title: Ask for the current canvas
items.description: A capture tool saves a PNG of what the canvas shows right now, so a drawing can be reviewed from the conversation.

items.title: A curve judged at real size
items.description: Paths are drawn, handles moved and fills set, then the canvas is captured — a curve is judged at the size it will be printed or shipped at.

items.title: Install the plugin
items.description: About 31 MB of editor files arrive on first open — including the layout fonts — and are reused offline after that.

items.title: Open the VectorCraft tab
items.description: Opening the tab shows the editor itself — no preparation screen, no package to fetch.

items.title: Select a drawing, then open it
items.description: File → Open inside the editor takes the file selected in Astravia rather than a system dialog.

items.title: Save the result back
items.description: The output goes through Astravia, so it can replace the source or become a new file.

blocks.content: Upstream ships an MCP server for scripted work; this plugin does not start it. In the tab, use the Agent tools that are listed in the skill — they talk to the running page.
Interface language: the editor itself is English only — upstream ships no other language. The tab shell and this page follow your Astravia language.
It draws a path, moves a handle and sets a fill, one step at a time. A change is reported after the canvas has been captured at the size the drawing will ship at.
